scope: system_v4/probes sim filenames containing claim-layer labels
claim_ceiling: filename-debt audit only; no sim result, no admission, no bulk rename instruction
policy: Do not bulk-rename legacy sims. When a flagged file is reused, copied, or promoted, rename or wrap it with an explicit pure-math name that describes the operation sequence, carrier/topology, observable, or solver predicate actually being tested.

next_admissible_step: Before reusing any listed file, inspect the body for banned claim-layer literals and choose a name from the actual operation sequence, carrier/topology, observable, solver predicate, and claim ceiling.
